metrics_finding.finding: order-service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, from 0.00903 to 0.6693833333333333, and mean latency increased from 2.017 to 0.6586666666666666.

evidence_summary.summary: Order service CPU utilization increased significantly, and mean latency increased

report.suggested_fix: Monitor order service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the order service. The high CPU utilization and increased mean latency suggest a potential bottleneck in the system. Further investigation is required to confirm this hypothesis.
report_text.hi: अनुपस्थिति की घटना के पीछे विश्वास है कि यह ऑर्डर सेवा से संबंधित है। उच्च CPU उपयोग और औसत लेटेंसी में वृद्धि सुझाव देती है कि प्रणाली में एक बोतलनाक हो सकता है। आगे की जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह सिद्ध किया जा सके।
